analysis.inspected_by: agent (GitHub Copilot, session B) using the reference-analyst workflow
analysis.method: Viewed overview (59 frames), the transitions sheet (all 8 boundaries, every 2nd frame = 15 fps for this 30 fps file), the audio panel and the listen sheet (1 phrase, 20 accent hits); automated audio and listen metrics (signal features; Windows desktop dictation for speech; nothing was listened to).
analysis.coverage: Full 44.0 s (1024x1280); every boundary on the sheet; accents checked against their frames; the arrangement read from the envelope and spectrogram.

concept.observed: A portrait promo for a social step-counting app on a dark canvas, in two acts: early morning, a step counter, a five-person race board counting down four minutes to a win; then a reflective line and a team climb up a layered mountain while a team counter rolls to 100,000 and the sky turns from night to dawn; an end card closes.
concept.interpreted: Competition, then cooperation. The music arrangement changes with the act, and the win is marked by light and a change of texture rather than a louder edit.

communication_style.observed: Short sentence-case lines under large glowing numbers; no voice.

palette.observed: Near-black (#080808, 49%) with neon lime-yellow numbers and glow, coloured avatar tiles; the mountain act in navy, slate and dawn pink-orange; mean luma 0.14.

typography.observed: Wide extended display face for numbers and the end headline; small sans for lines and labels.

composition.observed: Portrait: number top-centre, subject in the middle, a line or status pill near the bottom.

motion.observed: Counters roll continuously (5.6-10.1 s, 27.2-35.4 s); footprints walk up from the bottom; race columns rise under a countdown; a glowing route draws up the mountain; the sky palette shifts.

transitions.observed: Eight boundaries. 10.58 s: the counter fades while the race board builds in place over 0.6 s (continuous). 20.20 s: hard cut through an accent-colour flood; the frame turns lime for about 0.3 s while '1ST' bursts with particles (cut, flash). 22.25 s: fade to black over 0.5 s, black holds 0.9 s before the next line (continuous, act break). 26.92 s: fade up from black onto the mountain over 0.7 s (continuous). 30.92 and 32.58 s: stage-label changes during the continuous climb (continuous). 37.87 s: fade to black over 0.5 s, black about 0.7 s, end card up by 39.15 s (continuous, act break). 43.42 s: final fade out. Not detected: 0.6-1.9 s the time fades up; 23.5-25.7 s the two-line statement builds.
transitions.interpreted: Two act breaks through black and one flash at the climax; inside each act the stage never cuts.

timing_and_rhythm.observed: Static holds 0.08-0.92, 1.92-2.58 and 2.75-4.58 s (the opening waits on one line) and 24.58-25.75 s (the reflection).

sound_design.observed: -15.9 LUFS, LRA 7.9 LU, true peak -0.2 dBTP; tempo estimate 123 bpm (medium, autocorrelation 0.84); 30 accents (41/min), all inside the race (10.70-18.30 s) at 0.23-0.26 s spacing (eighth notes at about 123 bpm). Onsets per 4 s window rise from 8 (0-4 s) to 33 (12-16 s) and drop to 2 (20-24 s) after the win; the envelope peaks with a broadband swell at 20.2 s; sparse chords follow (20-30 s); the pulse returns for the climb (30.5-35 s) with a second swell at the summit (35.4 s). 0 of 8 boundaries carry an accent (chance 0.13); onsets on boundaries 0.38 (chance 0.36); silence 0.05-0.63 s; head 5.7 dB below the body, tail level. Accents may be part of the music.
sound_design.interpreted: The arrangement is the pacing: a dense pulse builds tension under the countdown and stops on the win; relief comes from the texture thinning, not from silence.

narration.observed: None: dictation kept 1 word (34.97-36.51 s) and its phrase frame shows the summit image under music, so it is recogniser noise; no speaker on screen.
narration.interpreted: Text-led film: the copy is on screen, timed to the music.

captions.observed: None as captions. Copy lanes: one short line centred about 60-65% down under the hero counter (5.6-10.1 s); a status pill at the bottom of the race board naming the gap to the leader, updated about every 0.75 s (12.3-20.5 s); a bottom-band line on the mountain (27-35 s); a centred two-line statement on black with the second line bold (23.5-25.7 s); a centred end card.

scenes.observed: Dark: the time and one line; a small dot pulses.
Step counter rolls with footprints; two lines.
Race board countdown with five avatars and a gap pill.
Win flash; '1st' and the winning margin.
Team climb: counter to 100,000, named camps, dawn, 'summit together'.
End card with tagline and a download button.

moments.observed: At zero the frame floods lime for about 0.3 s and '1ST' bursts with particles; the pulse that ran from 10.4 s stops and a broadband swell peaks.
moments.interpreted: The climax is light plus the end of a pulse, not a louder hit.

moments.observed: Over 8 s the team counter rolls from 0 to 100,000 while the sky warms from night blue to dawn and a glowing route draws up the mountain.

uncertainties: Whether the 0.245 s pulse is a clock-tick effect or the music's hi-hat
Exact fade curves (sheet sampled at 15 fps)
